svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make three. Hardwood board 600 x 300 x 50 mm, sawn square,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the grain along the 600 mm length.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: two 28 mm holes straight through, on the cross centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 85 mm each side of the middle (170 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band each end with 25 x 2 mm steel strap, 40 mm in from the end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nailed, so the board cannot split along the grain.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It lies with the 600 mm length pointing at the well, its near

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end at least 650 mm back from the rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The foot plate sits on top, its two holes over these holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the board lies flat on a floor without rocking.
